post.description:
Give the conversation to a teammate (`user_id`), or to nobody (`null`).

Only members of your shop can be assigned; any other id is `404`. Assigning does not pause

The customer, where they came from, the AI's pending draft and the follow-up, for the inbox's
side panel.

post.description:
Turn a short recording into text for the reply box (multipart field `audio`).

At most 60 seconds (decoded on the server) and 2 MB (`FILE_TOO_LARGE`). The type is judged by
the first bytes (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). Works while the reply window is closed. The audio
and the text are never stored or logged. Errors: `AI_ALLOWANCE_DAILY` (429), `AI_UNAVAILABLE`
(503), `TRANSCRIPT_EMPTY` (422).

Ask the AI for a fresh draft now, optionally from the merchant's note (`hint`).

Allowed when the reply window is closed (sending is not). The draft arrives through the inbox
stream and `GET .../context` once written, replacing the pending one. `409 AI_MODE_OFF` when
the merchant has switched the AI off, `409 NOTHING_TO_DRAFT` when the conversation has no
message yet, `429 AI_ALLOWANCE_DAILY` when today's budget is spent and `503 AI_UNAVAILABLE` when
no AI provider is configured, so the composer can say so instead of waiting for a draft that
never comes.
Discard the AI's draft, optionally saying why. Returns the refreshed side panel.

get.description: Newest first. Images come with short-lived URLs.

post.description:
Queue a reply. It is sent in the background; watch `send_status` (queued -> sent/failed).

Send an `Idempotency-Key` and reuse it when retrying: the same reply is never queued twice.
`unknown` means the channel did not confirm: do not resend until it settles to `failed`.
Send the AI draft's `draft_id` when the text is that draft (edited or not); a draft that was
already decided or replaced answers `409 DRAFT_NOT_PENDING`.

A reply is text, images, product cards, or a mix (`EMPTY_MESSAGE` if none). The images follow
the text in order, a few to a message where the channel shows them together (Messenger: up to
three, as a collage; 4 images go two and two), and the cards follow as one more; `batch` lists
the messages. A message of several images is sent, and fails, as one. If one message fails the
rest are not sent.

delete.description: Delete a reply that failed to send. Only `failed` messages can be deleted (`MESSAGE_NOT_FAILED`).

post.description:
Send a failed reply again. It moves to the end of the thread, `queued`, with the same id.

Only `failed` can go again (`MESSAGE_NOT_FAILED` otherwise): never resend `unknown`, which may
still arrive. The reply-window and channel rules are those of a new reply.

put.description: Persist the merchant's current preparation using a conversation-scoped version check.

post.description: Persist the exact request and key before sending an order creation attempt.

Rewrite the merchant's own text politely. Numbers are never changed: if the rewrite would
change one, the original comes back with `unchanged_numbers_guard`.
`429 AI_ALLOWANCE_DAILY`, `403 AI_REVIEW_PENDING` and `503 AI_UNAVAILABLE` leave the merchant's text as it was.
The merchant opened the thread: its unread count goes to zero.

delete.description: Bring a put-off conversation back now. Safe to repeat.

post.description:
Put an open conversation off until `until` ("Later"), optionally saying why.

It leaves Open and Unread until then and comes back by itself, or earlier when the customer
writes or you reply, close or reopen it. A flagged conversation stays in Needs you. Sending
the same body again changes nothing. A closed conversation answers `409 CONVERSATION_NOT_OPEN`.
Save a courier account. The response carries the webhook secret, shown this once.

post.description:
Book up to 100 confirmed orders with one courier account. Each order is accepted (a
`requested` shipment, booked in the background) or refused with the same codes as booking one.
A problem with the account itself (`COURIER_NOT_CONNECTED`, `COURIER_CONNECTION_BROKEN`,
`PICKUP_STORE_REQUIRED`) refuses the whole request. Send an `Idempotency-Key`.

an estimate from the connection's rate card. `kind: unavailable` says why there is no figure
(`location_not_matched`: send the courier's `city_ref` and `zone_ref`). Stores nothing and
never changes the order.

Record the consignment id of a booking whose outcome was unknown, after finding the parcel
in the courier's panel. Its status is then read from the courier.
Ask the courier for the parcel's status now, instead of waiting for its webhook.
